Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: borderless square game action-bar icon for the shared pet command family in World of ClaudeCraft
Primary request: create fresh, distinct, premium hand-painted dark-fantasy MMORPG icon art for Pet Attack (pet_attack)
Canonical mechanic: commands the player's summoned animal, elemental, or demon companion to attack the current hostile target.

Keep the paw creature-neutral so it can represent beast, elemental, or demon pets. Do not depict a full humanoid, weapon, button cursor, paw-print emblem, or blood.

Composition/framing: one dominant readable diagonal action, visually centered, subject fills 78 to 86 percent with safe margins; the claws and target spark must remain recognizable at 32px, 40px, and 48px. Strong silhouette, three broad value groups, crisp focal edges with softer peripheral atmosphere.
Reference roles: bestial_wrath is subject mood and animal-energy reference only; counter_shot is the clarity, impact, and premium painted-finish reference; deep_wounds is the dark-value and controlled crimson reference. Create a new composition and do not copy their exact subjects.
Lighting/mood: deep values, restrained saturation, warm rim light on the striking paw, clear target-directed motion.
Constraints: opaque square; no transparency; no text, letters, numbers, border, frame, rarity chrome, UI button chrome, watermark, modern graphic design, flat glyph, logo, gore, blood splatter, duplicated paws, cropped claws, or tiny decorative detail.
